extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.subtitle: Optional tools Orqen can use. Orqen never downloads or installs them: you register a binary you already have.
extensions.sheetHelp: Register, detect, test and enable this extension.

unusable.changed: The binary changed; test it again.

extensions.detectOnlyNote: This entry is detect-only: Orqen can find and test it but never runs it, so it has no Enable.
extensions.detectNeedsLicense: Detect is unavailable until the license is accepted.
extensions.detectNeedsBinary: Detect is unavailable until a binary is registered.

guidance.title: How to get it
guidance.generic: Install it yourself, then register its path here.
guidance.noDownload: Orqen never downloads or installs anything.

openclaw-wiki.text: Install the OpenClaw Wiki command-line tool yourself and register the path to its binary.

gitlab-mcp.text: Install a GitLab MCP server yourself and register the path to its binary.

strix.text: Install Strix yourself (it needs Docker) and register the path to its binary.

figma-mcp.text: Install a Figma MCP server yourself and register the path to its binary.

gitnexus.text: Install GitNexus yourself after reading its license, then register the path to its binary.

mcp-atlassian.text: Install an Atlassian MCP server yourself and register the path to its binary.

binary.title: Binary
binary.hint: The file is never copied; Orqen records its path and checksum.
binary.noCandidates: No candidates were found on this machine.

license.title: License for {{name}}
license.required: This extension needs a license acceptance before it can be used.
license.noteHint: Why this use is covered. It is stored with the acceptance.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.help: Secrets are write-only: they are stored in the OS credential store and are never shown again.

projects.title: Projects
projects.needsEnabled: Enable the extension before binding projects.
